mostWorthwhile.text: Treating the cloudy well water and filling the tank was the strongest payoff, connecting the extraction steps to a first drink.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the insulation was a predictable intermediate step with little explanation on its own.

surprise.text: The final fitting clarified that the hose is heat-traced: the insulation slows heat loss rather than providing heat itself.

arbitrary.text: Connecting the well line at the processor felt slightly redundant after the hose had already joined them, although starting treatment was a clear purpose.

continue.text: Yes. The practical details about water treatment and keeping the line warm make me curious how the expedition's next problems will unfold, though the offered combinations made the decisions straightforward.
